items.title: Kroger (KR) Stock Looks Fully Priced After A 67% Run
items.summary: Kroger has delivered a strong multi year return, yet with the stock around US$60 today and fresh headlines about pricing, private labels and store investment, the live question is whether that share price still lines up with the earnings behind it. Over the past 5 years the stock has gained 67.3%, which puts extra weight on whether the current earnings profile can carry that kind of value creation from here. items.title: Can Kroger Keep Its Earnings Promise With Sales This Weak?
items.summary: Kroger (KR) has cut its 2026 same-store sales outlook and kept its 2026 profit outlook. If you own the stock, the easy comfort is that earnings held. The risk sits inside that comfort. The cost savings holding up profit are the same savings management plans to spend on lower shelf prices, and the stock is down 15% over the past six months.
